notes: Every primary button on every page was connected to nothing - Compute, Generate, Import, Fit the design, Find the toe, Design the dam, Build the corridor and Work out the rate all did nothing when pressed. They work. Twenty-two tools could not be found from Ctrl+K at all, including Merge, Clip to boundary, Grid DTM and Mark control; every one of the window's 159 controls is now searchable. And the volume report no longer makes you wait: on a real 4.5 km job it took 73 seconds, all of it a 1 m grid check cross-checking a number it agreed with to 1.4 cubic metres in six million. The check now follows the size of the site and takes one second.
